environment.description: Same ASP.NET Core 8.0 application deployed on Azure App Service (Basic tier B1) behind Azure Front Door Premium with a custom rule set. The Front Door profile has a rate limit rule (Microsoft.Network/frontDoorWebApplicationFirewallPolicies) configured as: match condition on RequestUri containing '/api/DirectorySearch/', rate limit type 'threshold', threshold value 3 requests per 1-minute window per SocketAddr, action 'Block' (returns 429). Additionally, a second custom rule at priority 5 with match condition on QueryString using regex pattern matching for LDAP metacharacters [()\\*|&!] with action 'Block' (returns 403). The WAF policy is in Prevention mode and associated with the Front Door endpoint route. The application's custom domain resolves exclusively through Front Door (origin access restricted via Front Door ID header validation in app middleware).

config.network: VNet integrated, LDAP port 389 open to app subnet
